newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle Micro sees Q1 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle Micro sees Q1 operating loss.

text.p: Pinnacle Micro Inc said Thursday it expects to report an operating loss of about $3 million for its first fiscal quarter.

The company also said in a statement that among other things it has cut its workforce by 20 percent over the past year in an attempt to reduce costs. After the cuts Pinnacle has 150 employees. The company also reorganized its European sales operations.
Pinnacle had an operating loss of $3.9 million in the comparable year-ago period.
The company said it will record a noncash interest expense of about $800,000 during the quarter, taking the net loss to about $4 million for the quarter.
The company said it expects first quarter revenues will be about $14 million compared with $17.4 million in the first quarter of 1996.
The company said new orders for Apex drives were lower than expected for the quarter while sales of Apex-based optical library systems and recordable CDs exceeded expectations.
